notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content: [p]Hey peasants,[/p][p]thank you for volunteering to torture yourself by testing my unpolished, excruciatingly boring game.[/p][p]*cough* I mean:[/p][p]Please bear in mind that this is the first version of my game, and I'm sure there are still things to improve. I think it's fairly polished, but since this is my first game release, there might be a few pitfalls I've overlooked.[/p][p][/p][p]If you experience any issues, are missing hotkeys or have suggestions to improve my game, please contact me. I'm happy to receive any feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards[/p][p]Max Krupp[/p][p][b]contact@maxkrupp.de[/b][/p][p]Solo Deveveloper, Game Designer, Art Designer, Graphic Engineer, Audio Engineer and everything else involved in this game. ːsteammockingː[/p][p][/p][p]PS: Sorry for my dark humor. I love you all. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p]
